invariants.rationale: Since 'fillY' is a float field, the returned value should usually be finite; this is plausible unless 'fillY' can be set to infinity or NaN.
This is not a real invariant, just a placeholder, so it won't appear in the final output unless 'result' is always zero, which is not indicated here.
It may be reasonable that fillY (and thus result) is never NaN, which is common for well-behaved layout code.
